title: 第一天进厂报到，英语怎么说？
summary: 第一天上班要找组长报到、领工服、问厕所和休息室在哪儿。这篇教你报到当天的必备英语。

featuredPhrase.en: Where do I go on my first day?

phrases.en: Where do I go on my first day?
Can you show me how to do this?

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.en: Hi, it's my first day. Where should I go?
dialogue.zh: 你好，我第一天上班，该去哪儿？

dialogue.speaker: Team Lead
dialogue.en: Welcome! Come with me. I'll show you around.
dialogue.zh: 欢迎！跟我来，我带你转转。

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.en: Where is the break room and the bathroom?

dialogue.speaker: Team Lead
dialogue.en: Down this hall on the left. Lunch is at 12.
dialogue.zh: 这条走廊往前左手边。12 点吃午饭。

seoTitle: 第一天进厂报到英语怎么说？
seoDescription: 第一天去工厂上班，报到、找休息室、问午饭时间怎么说？本文教你报到当天的实用英语和完整对话。
